children: Shares of Thermax and Info Edge (India) rose up to 4 percent in Friday's trade after Kotak Equities upgraded both stocks to 'Buy'.
Thermax shares rose 3.8 percent to Rs 3,257.50 on the NSE, while Info Edge shares gained 2.65 percent to Rs 1,214.20.
Kotak Institutional Equities upgraded Thermax to 'Buy' with a target price of Rs 4,000, saying the stock's valuation was attractive given its growth prospects.
The brokerage said Thermax was trading at 35 times its estimated FY2028 earnings and expected the company's revenue to grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 16 percent over FY2026-29.

It expects businesses in their early stages, including data centres in the US and India and compressed biogas, to contribute an additional 5-6 percentage points to revenue growth. These businesses are expected to benefit from Thermax's strong competitive positioning and expanding market opportunities.

The brokerage also expects margins to remain favourable, supported by the completion of legacy orders and a higher contribution from segments such as power, TBWES and services, which have higher margins.
Kotak Institutional Equities also upgraded Info Edge to 'Buy', setting a target price of Rs 1,400 per share.
The brokerage noted that Info Edge's recruitment segment reported billings growth of 12.6 percent in the second quarter of FY2027.

Citing the company's press release, it said the performance was affected by one-off deferrals in renewals. This led the brokerage to maintain its expectation of 14-15 percent billings growth for FY2027, compared with 14.9 percent growth in the first half of the fiscal.
The brokerage also highlighted an acceleration in billings growth at 99acres to 21.2 percent and expects profitability in the segment to improve steadily.

Addtionally, JPMorgan has an 'overweight' rating on Info Edge with a target price of Rs 1,500 per share, implying an upside of about 26 percent from its previous closing price. Citi has also maintained a 'Buy' recommendation on the stock, with an upside potential of up to 27 percent.

title: Thermax, Info Edge rise up to 4% as Kotak Equities upgrades both stocks to 'Buy'
